info.title: Wabiz CRM API
info.description: Wabiz CRM - Multi-tenant WhatsApp CRM SaaS Platform API

post.description: Create a new user account and return authentication token
Authenticate user with email and password, return authentication token
Logout the authenticated user and revoke their token

get.description: Retrieve all active subscription plans with pricing, limits, and features. This is a public endpoint.
Retrieve the authenticated user's active subscription with plan details, remaining days, and usage stats.

post.description: Create a new subscription for the authenticated user. For free plans, subscription activates immediately. For paid plans, provide a payment ID from the gateway.
Upgrade to a different plan. Cancels the current subscription and creates a new one.

plan_id.description: New plan ID to upgrade to

post.description: Cancel the authenticated user's active subscription.
Renew the user's most recent subscription plan with a new billing period.

get.description: Retrieve paginated payment transaction history for the authenticated user.

post.description: Handles Razorpay payment events (payment.captured, payment.failed). This is a public endpoint called by Razorpay.
Handles Stripe payment events (checkout.session.completed, payment_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.payment_failed). This is a public endpoint called by Stripe.

get.description: Get high-level KPIs: total leads, orders, revenue, messages, followups, conversion rate. All data scoped to the authenticated user.
Get lead breakdown by status, source, daily growth, and monthly growth. Chart-ready labels/datasets format.
Get orders by status, daily/monthly revenue, top 10 customers, and average order value.
Get incoming/outgoing message counts and messages-per-day breakdown.
Get sent/pending/failed followup counts and per-day breakdown.
Get all chart-ready data in a single call: lead funnel, revenue trend (30d), message activity (30d), lead sources pie, order status distribution.
Retrieve all follow-ups for leads owned by the authenticated user with optional filtering and pagination

post.description: Schedule a new follow-up message for a lead. The message will be sent automatically when scheduled_at time arrives.

message.example: Hi! Just following up on our conversation.

get.description: Retrieve all follow-ups for a specific lead owned by the authenticated user

put.description: Update an existing pending follow-up. Only pending follow-ups can be updated.

delete.description: Delete a follow-up. Only pending follow-ups can be deleted.

post.description: Immediately dispatch a pending follow-up to the queue for sending, regardless of scheduled_at time.

400.description: Follow-up is not in pending status

patch.description: Manually change the status of a follow-up (e.g., reset a failed follow-up to pending for retry).

get.description: Retrieve all leads with optional filtering, searching and pagination

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by lead name or phone

post.description: Create a new lead in the system

get.description: Retrieve a specific lead with all relationships

delete.description: Delete a lead from the system

get.description: Get statistics about leads including counts by status and source
Retrieve all messages for a specific lead owned by the authenticated user, with pagination and optional type filter

post.description: Send a text message to a lead via WhatsApp Cloud API using the authenticated user's WhatsApp account credentials

message.example: Hello! How can we help you?
Failed to send message via WhatsApp

get.description: Retrieve all orders for leads owned by the authenticated user with optional filtering, searching and pagination

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by lead name, phone or order ID

post.description: Create a new order with multiple items. Total price is auto-calculated. Sends WhatsApp notification to the lead.

get.description: Retrieve a specific order with all items and lead details

put.description: Update order status and/or items. Sends WhatsApp notification on status change to shipped or delivered.

delete.description: Delete an order. Only pending orders can be deleted.

get.description: Retrieve all orders for a specific lead
Revenue stats, orders by status, monthly sales, and top customers for the authenticated user
Retrieve the authenticated user's business settings. Auto-creates with defaults if none exist.

put.description: Update business profile, timezone, country code, automation toggles, and default template assignments.

403.description: Template does not belong to user

post.description: Upload a business logo image. Max 2MB. Accepts JPEG, PNG, GIF, SVG, WEBP.

patch.description: Enable or disable individual automation features: follow-up, welcome message, or order notifications.

post.description: Reset all settings to factory defaults. Clears business profile, logo, timezone, automation toggles, and template assignments.

get.description: Retrieve all message templates for the authenticated user with optional filtering by category, status, and search

post.description: Create a new message template with dynamic variable support. Variables use {{variable_name}} syntax.

content.example: Hi {{name}}, your order #{{order_id}} has been shipped! Total: Rs. {{total}}

get.description: Retrieve a specific template by ID with its extracted variables

put.description: Update an existing template's name, category, content, variables, or status

post.description: Create a copy of an existing template with a new name and slug
Render a template with sample data to see how it will look. Variables not provided in sample_data will show as [variable_name].

original_content.example: Hi {{name}}, your order #{{order_id}} has been shipped!

rendered_content.example: Hi John Doe, your order #12345 has been shipped!

get.description: Get available categories and system-recognized variables for building templates
Get the WhatsApp account details for the authenticated user

put.description: Update the WhatsApp Cloud API credentials for the authenticated user

post.description: Connect a WhatsApp Cloud API account for the authenticated user. Each user can have only one WhatsApp account.

message.example: You already have a WhatsApp account connected

delete.description: Disconnect and remove the WhatsApp Cloud API account for the authenticated user

get.description: Handles Meta webhook verification challenge. Returns hub.challenge if verify_token matches any connected WhatsApp account.

parameters.name: hub.verify_token
parameters.description: The verify token set in Meta App Dashboard

200.description: Webhook verified successfully — returns challenge string

post.description: Receives incoming WhatsApp messages from Meta Cloud API. Routes to correct tenant via phone_number_id, auto-creates lead if phone number is new for that tenant, and saves the message.

message.example: Hello! How can we help you?
